title: doritis mirabilis
intro: Doritis mirabilis, commonly known as the Mirabilis Orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support the immune system due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Doritis mirabilis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
